- memory_id "1000225": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory use growth after the cache change and pinged the ledger service's owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)

- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000312" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000362": feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1000314": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, the full reindex)
- memory_id "1000319": The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails.  (about: product catalog, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000092": The Ember team is currently a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
